$description: Every route declared in src/App.jsx, resolved to the template that ACTUALLY renders it. Exactly one template per route; no gaps, no double assignment.
resolutionRule: react-router v6 ranks static segments above dynamic ones and, for equal scores, keeps declaration order. Captured routes are declared first in App.jsx, so where a captured page and a live-DOM template claim the same path, the capture wins.
